data.one_liner: A Flutter refresh library for pull-down refresh and pull-up load with customizable indicators.
data.what_it_does: Provides a SmartRefresher widget that wraps scroll components like ListView and GridView to support pull-down refresh, pull-up load, custom animations, and physics configurations. It includes multiple indicators like classic, water drop, and material styles.
use_when: You need custom pull-to-refresh and load-more behaviors on scroll views.
You want advanced overscroll and spring physics customization.
You require global indicator configurations for your app's refresh components.
avoid_when: You are using a setup where the SmartRefresher cannot be the direct parent of the ScrollView.
You only need the built-in RefreshIndicator from Material.
strengths: Supports almost all ScrollWidgets like ListView, GridView, and CustomScrollView.
Provides numerous built-in refresh styles, indicators, and two-level refresh effects.
Extensive global configuration options for physics, spring animations, and behaviors.
weaknesses: Strict requirement that the ScrollView must be the direct child of SmartRefresher without nesting intermediates.
Can be incompatible with certain PageView and TabBarView configurations depending on settings.
data.minimal_example:
RefreshController _refreshController = RefreshController(initialRefresh: false);

SmartRefresher(
  enablePullDown: true,
  enablePullUp: true,
  controller: _refreshController,
  onRefresh: _onRefresh,
  onLoading: _onLoading,
  child: ListView.builder(
    itemBuilder: (c, i) => Card(child: Center(child: Text('Item $i'))),
    itemCount: 10,
  ),
)
